sections.content: Use direct speech to reproduce exact words and indirect speech to report what someone said without quoting the exact words.

items.english: She said that she was tired.

items.spanish: El testigo dijo que no había visto nada.
items.english: The witness said that he had not seen anything.

sections.content: Unlike English, which can drop 'that' — 'She said she was tired' — Spanish indirect speech always keeps *que*: dijo *que* *estaba* cansada.
